description: Phase 14: multi-object comparison. Fixture has five squares of distinct colours and sizes. The blue square (110x110) is the largest. The prompt asks which colour is the largest square; correct answer contains 'blue'.

image_fixture.license: Crucible-owned synthetic; no real PII; generated by scripts/generate-vision-fixtures.py (phase14 v1)
image_fixture.notes: Five squares left-to-right: red(60), green(80), yellow(70), orange(90), blue(110). Blue is unambiguously the largest.

questions.question: Look at the five coloured squares. Which colour is the largest square? Answer with one word — the colour name.

metadata.author: crucibulum-core
metadata.diagnostic_purpose: POC for relative-size comparison across multiple objects. Pass requires 'blue' substring within 80 chars (single-colour answer).

known_scoring_limitations: Bare substring 'blue' would PASS if a model named all five colours. The 80-char max_chars cap rules out the 'list every colour' answer.
